pythonFunction.name: fetch_account_by_number
pythonFunction.description:
Identifies the account from an account number the customer says or keys in (deepest Tier 1
fallback). The number is never repeated back. Before calling this tool, speak a brief
conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_num: Account number, spoken, keyed or typed (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, found and, on one match, the Identified account summary; attempts_remaining
    on a miss; account_locked true when the online account is locked (offer the unlock flow).
